description:
- Added Firebase-backed user data sync for the phone app.
- Signed-in users now get a Firestore profile document.
- Shared app settings and phone settings can sync through Firebase.
- Watch history and continue watching can sync through Firebase.
- Cloud history merges with local history for faster loading.

releases.description:
- Started the account and profile path for cross-device syncing.
- First-open screen now offers email login, Google login, and skip.
- Watch history is limited to signed-in users.
- Continue watching is limited to signed-in users.
- The home toolbar profile button opens login or profile based on auth state.
